description:
SalesTouch is the LinkedIn MCP for AI agents. Connect ChatGPT or Codex to LinkedIn tools to find prospects, research context, build relationships and keep outreach moving from one conversation.

Extract prospect lists from LinkedIn searches, posts and groups. Read profiles, company information and conversation histories, then prepare and send contextual invitations, messages and follow-ups. Inspect action status and cancel queued work when needed.

Scheduled actions can continue in the cloud after your agent closes. OAuth permissions, account controls, daily limits, working hours, queues, cooldowns and activity logs keep execution within your settings.

Production use requires a SalesTouch account with an active trial or plan and a connected LinkedIn account. Sales Navigator is optional for supported premium sources.

defaultPrompt: Research this prospect and summarize their current role and company: [LinkedIn profile URL]
Find my latest conversation with [LinkedIn profile URL] and suggest the next follow-up.
Extract the people who commented on this LinkedIn post and show the first 10: [LinkedIn post URL]
